faults.why: 'Shani-ravivar' is not a standard traditional term for weekend; the formal Hindi word is सप्ताहांत.

faults.quote: We will go out to roam on the weekend.
faults.why: 'Go out to roam' is a calque of 'घूमने जाना'; natural English is 'go out'.
